title: Can You Remember 15 Synonyms for BEAUTIFUL? (Memory Challenge)
description:
Ten words for BEAUTIFUL in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole BEAUTIFUL ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from nice to look at to extremely beautiful: cute, pretty, picturesque, lovely, attractive, good-looking, handsome, elegant, graceful, exquisite, striking, radiant, gorgeous, stunning, breathtaking. For each word, you learn what it means and who or what it is for: babies and small animals ("cute"), men ("handsome"), places and views ("a picturesque village", "a breathtaking view"), the way someone or something moves ("graceful"), small, delicate things ("exquisite jewellery"), happy faces ("a radiant smile"), and casual chat ("gorgeous" is a bit informal).

Tonight, try it with your own new words: one silly story, one picture for each word.

For more words, look up "another word for beautiful" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-beautiful/
